text.opengl: Compute a light-space matrix for each of the five cascades every frame and put them into a uniform buffer: the split distances `shadowCascadeLevels` (far / 50, / 25, / 10, / 2), `getFrustumCornersWorldSpace` (the 8 corners of a frustum from the inverse of projection · view), `getLightSpaceMatrix(near, far)` (a light view looking at the corners' centre along the light direction, an orthographic box around the corners in light space, its depth range stretched by 10) and `getLightSpaceMatrices()`; the UBO (16 matrices, binding point 0) filled with `glBufferSubData` each frame.
text.vulkan: Compute a light-space matrix for each of the five cascades every frame and put them into a second uniform buffer: the split distances `shadowCascadeLevels` (far / 50, / 25, / 10, / 2), `getFrustumCornersWorldSpace` (the 8 corners of a frustum from the inverse of projection · view – in Vulkan's depth range z = 0..1), `getLightSpaceMatrix(near, far)` and `getLightSpaceMatrices()`; the buffer (`struct LightSpaceMatrices { glm::mat4 lightSpaceMatrices[16]; }`) at binding 2 of the descriptor set, filled in `updateUniformBuffer()`.
text.d3d12: Compute a light-space matrix for each of the five cascades every frame and put them into a constant buffer: the split distances `shadowCascadeLevels`, `getFrustumCornersWorldSpace` (the 8 corners of a frustum from the inverse of view · projection – z from 0 to 1 in Direct3D), `getLightSpaceMatrix(near, far)` (a light view looking at the corners' centre along the light direction, an orthographic box around the corners in light space, its depth range stretched by 10) and `getLightSpaceMatrices()`; the constant buffer (16 matrices, CBV in heap slot 3, root parameter 3 at b2).

hint.opengl: learnopengl's functions, with the camera globals instead of the `Camera` class: `glm::perspective(glm::radians(fov), (float)SCR_WIDTH / (float)SCR_HEIGHT, nearPlane, farPlane)` and `glm::lookAt(cameraPos, cameraPos + cameraFront, cameraUp)`. Corners: `inv * glm::vec4(2.0f * x - 1.0f, 2.0f * y - 1.0f, 2.0f * z - 1.0f, 1.0f)`, divided by `w`. UBO: `glBufferData(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER, sizeof(glm::mat4x4) * 16, nullptr, GL_STATIC_DRAW); glBindBufferBase(GL_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 0, matricesUBO);`.
hint.vulkan: learnopengl's functions with the camera globals: `glm::perspective(glm::radians(fov), (float)WIDTH / (float)HEIGHT, nearPlane, farPlane)`, `glm::lookAt(cameraPos, cameraPos + cameraFront, cameraUp)`. The buffer like the first one (`createBuffer` with `VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT`, host visible, `vkMapMemory` once); a layout binding 2 (`VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER`, `VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT`), a third descriptor write, two uniform buffers in the pool. In `updateUniformBuffer()`: `const std::vector<glm::mat4> lightMatrices = getLightSpaceMatrices();`, copy them into a `LightSpaceMatrices` and `memcpy` it.
hint.d3d12: `XMMatrixInverse(nullptr, projview)`, `XMVector4Transform(XMVectorSet(2.0f * x - 1.0f, 2.0f * y - 1.0f, static_cast<float>(z), 1.0f), inv)`, divided by `XMVectorSplatW(pt)`. `XMMatrixLookAtRH(center + lightDir, center, up)`, `XMMatrixOrthographicOffCenterRH(minX, maxX, minY, maxY, minZ, maxZ)`, `lightView * lightProjection`. The root signature gets `ranges[2].Init(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_CBV, 1, 2)` and `rootParameters[3]`; `PopulateCommandList` sets table 3 at heap slot 3.

text.opengl: Create the shadow maps – a framebuffer with a `GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT32F` 2D texture array of 1024 × 1024 × 5 layers attached as a layered depth attachment, no colour buffer – and render the scene's depth into all five layers in one pass: the geometry shader runs 5 times per triangle (`invocations = 5`), transforms it with `lightSpaceMatrices[gl_InvocationID]` and sends it to layer `gl_InvocationID`. For now show layer 2 of the array on a screen quad instead of the scene.
text.vulkan: Create the shadow maps – a depth image with 5 layers (1024 × 1024), a 2D-array view of all layers, a layered framebuffer (`layers = 5`) for a depth-only render pass, a white-border sampler – and render the scene's depth into all five layers in one pass: the geometry shader runs 5 times per triangle (`invocations = 5`), transforms it with `lightSpaceMatrices[gl_InvocationID]` and sends it to layer `gl_InvocationID`. For now show layer 2 of the array on the debug quad instead of the scene.
text.d3d12: Create the shadow maps – a depth texture array of 1024 × 1024 × 5 layers (`R32_TYPELESS`) with a DSV of all layers and a `Texture2DArray` SRV – and render the scene's depth into all five layers in one pass: the geometry shader runs 5 times per triangle (`[instance(5)]`), transforms it with `lightSpaceMatrices[invocation]` and sends it to layer `invocation` (`SV_RenderTargetArrayIndex`). For now show layer 2 of the array on the debug quad instead of the scene.

hint.opengl: `glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, lightDepthMaps); glTexImage3D(GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, 0, GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT32F, depthMapResolution, depthMapResolution, int(shadowCascadeLevels.size()) + 1, 0, GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT, GL_FLOAT, nullptr);`, `GL_CLAMP_TO_BORDER` with border 1.0, `glFramebufferTexture(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, lightDepthMaps, 0);` (all layers), `glDrawBuffer(GL_NONE); glReadBuffer(GL_NONE);`. The depth pass: `simpleDepthShader.use()`, bind `lightFBO`, `glViewport(0, 0, depthMapResolution, depthMapResolution)`, clear the depth, `renderScene(simpleDepthShader)`. The debug view: `if (showQuad)` – `debugDepthQuad.setInt("layer", debugLayer)`, the array on unit 0, `renderQuad()`.
hint.vulkan: `createDepthMapRenderPass()` (the Shadow Mapping chapter's), `createDepthMaps()` (`imageInfo.arrayLayers = 5`, `viewInfo.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY`, `subresourceRange.layerCount = 5`, `framebufferInfo.layers = 5`), `createDepthMapSampler()` (`VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_BORDER`, `VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_WHITE`). `deviceFeatures.geometryShader = VK_TRUE` (and check it in `isDeviceSuitable`). The depth pipeline: `createPipeline("shaders/shadow_mapping_depth.vert.spv", "shaders/shadow_mapping_depth.frag.spv", "shaders/shadow_mapping_depth.geom.spv", 1, depthMapRenderPass, 0, depthPipeline)`; the debug pipeline with `debug_quad`. The shadow maps at binding 3 (`createDescriptorSet(…, lightDepthMapsView, depthMapSampler, …)`). `int layer;` in `PushConstants` and the push constants for both stages. In `recordCommandBuffer()` the depth pass before the window pass (viewport and scissor 1024 × 1024, `renderScene`), and `if (showQuad)` the debug pipeline with `constants.layer = debugLayer` and the quad (vertices 42..47).
hint.d3d12: `CD3DX12_RESOURCE_DESC::Tex2D(DXGI_FORMAT_R32_TYPELESS, depthMapResolution, depthMapResolution, layers, 1, 1, 0, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL)` with `layers = shadowCascadeLevels.size() + 1`; `dsvDesc.ViewDimension = D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY; dsvDesc.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = layers;`, `srvDesc.ViewDimension = D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY`. The depth pass: `m_depthPipelineState` (VS + GS, `psoDesc.GS`), the shadow viewport, `OMSetRenderTargets(0, nullptr, FALSE, &shadowDsvHandle)`, clear, `RenderScene()`, the barrier. The debug view: `bool showQuad = true; int debugLayer = 2;`, `if (showQuad)` – `m_debugQuadPipelineState`, `DebugConstants`, `DrawInstanced(6, 1, 42, 0)`.

text.opengl: Back to the scene (`showQuad = false`). Give the scene shader the cascades – the view matrix, `farPlane`, `cascadePlaneDistances[16]`, `cascadeCount` – and a function `CascadeLayer` that picks a fragment's cascade from its depth in view space: the first cascade whose far distance is beyond it, else the last. For now tint every fragment with its cascade's colour (red, green, blue, yellow, magenta) to see where the cascades are.
text.vulkan: Back to the scene (`showQuad = false`). Give the scene shader the cascades – `farPlane`, `cascadeCount` and `cascadePlaneDistances[16]` in the uniform buffer (the view matrix is there already) – and a function `CascadeLayer` that picks a fragment's cascade from its depth in view space: the first cascade whose far distance is beyond it, else the last. For now tint every fragment with its cascade's colour (red, green, blue, yellow, magenta).
text.d3d12: Back to the scene (`showQuad = false`). Give the scene shader the cascades – `farPlane`, `cascadePlaneDistances[16]`, `cascadeCount` in the constant buffer (filled in `OnUpdate`) – and a function `CascadeLayer` that picks a fragment's cascade from its depth in view space: the first cascade whose far distance is beyond it, else the last. For now tint every fragment with its cascade's colour (red, green, blue, yellow, magenta).

hint.opengl: In the loop: `shader.setFloat("farPlane", cameraFarPlane); shader.setInt("cascadeCount", shadowCascadeLevels.size());` and `shader.setFloat("cascadePlaneDistances[" + std::to_string(i) + "]", shadowCascadeLevels[i]);` in a loop. `CascadeLayer`: `float depthValue = abs((view * vec4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0)).z);`, then learnopengl's `for` loop with `break`. Tint: `lighting *= cascadeColors[CascadeLayer(fs_in.FragPos)];` with `vec3(1.0, 0.4, 0.4)`, `(0.4, 1.0, 0.4)`, `(0.4, 0.4, 1.0)`, `(1.0, 1.0, 0.4)`, `(1.0, 0.4, 1.0)`.
hint.vulkan: In `UniformBufferObject` replace the two padding floats by `float farPlane;` and `int cascadeCount;` and add `glm::vec4 cascadePlaneDistances[16];` (std140 arrays: 16 bytes per element); in `updateUniformBuffer()` `ubo.farPlane = cameraFarPlane; ubo.cascadeCount = static_cast<int>(shadowCascadeLevels.size());` and `ubo.cascadePlaneDistances[i] = glm::vec4(shadowCascadeLevels[i]);`. The same block in `shadow_mapping.frag`; `CascadeLayer`: `float depthValue = abs((ubo.view * vec4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0)).z);`, learnopengl's `for` loop over `ubo.cascadePlaneDistances[i].x` with `break`. Tint: `lighting *= cascadeColors[CascadeLayer(fs_in.fragPos)];`.
hint.d3d12: C++: `XMFLOAT3 lightDir; float farPlane; XMFLOAT4 cascadePlaneDistances[16]; int cascadeCount;` and `constantBufferData.cascadePlaneDistances[i].x = shadowCascadeLevels[i];` in a loop. HLSL: the same fields, `float depthValue = abs(mul(float4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0f), view).z);`, learnopengl's loop with `break`; `static const float3 cascadeColors[5]` and `lighting *= cascadeColors[CascadeLayer(input.fragPos)];`.

text.opengl: Shadows: the scene shader gets the shadow map array (`sampler2DArray shadowMap`, unit 1) and the `LightSpaceMatrices` block; `ShadowCalculation` transforms the fragment with its cascade's light-space matrix, maps it to 0..1, returns 0 beyond the light's far plane, scales the bias by the cascade's far distance, and compares with one sample of that layer. Remove the debug tint.
text.vulkan: Shadows: the scene shader gets the light-space matrices (binding 2) and the shadow map array (`sampler2DArray shadowMap`, binding 3); `ShadowCalculation` transforms the fragment with its cascade's light-space matrix, maps x and y to 0..1, returns 0 beyond the light's far plane, scales the bias by the cascade's far distance, and compares with one sample of that layer. Remove the debug tint.
text.d3d12: Shadows: the scene shader gets the shadow maps (`Texture2DArray shadowMap : register(t1)`, sampler s1) and the `LightSpaceMatrices` cbuffer (b2); `ShadowCalculation` transforms the fragment with its cascade's light-space matrix, maps x and y to texture coordinates (v flipped), returns 0 beyond the light's far plane, scales the bias by the cascade's far distance, and compares with one sample of that layer. Remove the debug tint.

hint.opengl: `vec4 fragPosLightSpace = lightSpaceMatrices[layer] * vec4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0); vec3 projCoords = fragPosLightSpace.xyz / fragPosLightSpace.w * 0.5 + 0.5;` – with `bias *= 1 / (cascadePlaneDistances[layer] * biasModifier)` (or `farPlane` for the last cascade, `biasModifier = 0.5`) and `texture(shadowMap, vec3(projCoords.xy, layer)).r`. In C++: `shader.setInt("shadowMap", 1);`, `glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE1); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, lightDepthMaps);`.
hint.vulkan: `vec4 fragPosLightSpace = lightSpaceMatrices[layer] * vec4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0); vec3 projCoords = fragPosLightSpace.xyz / fragPosLightSpace.w; projCoords.xy = projCoords.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;` – z is in 0..1 already. `bias *= 1 / (ubo.cascadePlaneDistances[layer].x * biasModifier)` (or `ubo.farPlane` for the last cascade, `biasModifier = 0.5`), `texture(shadowMap, vec3(projCoords.xy, layer)).r`. Nothing to do in C++: the descriptor set has both since `depth-maps` and `light-matrices`.
hint.d3d12: `float4 fragPosLightSpace = mul(float4(fragPosWorldSpace, 1.0f), lightSpaceMatrices[layer]);`, `projCoords = fragPosLightSpace.xyz / fragPosLightSpace.w`, `shadowUV = float2(projCoords.x * 0.5f + 0.5f, -projCoords.y * 0.5f + 0.5f)`, `bias *= 1.0f / (cascadePlaneDistances[layer].x * biasModifier)` (`farPlane` for the last cascade, `biasModifier = 0.5f`), `shadowMap.Sample(shadowSampler, float3(shadowUV, layer)).r`. The C++ side already binds everything (the table t0/t1, root parameter 3).

pcf.text: Soften the shadow edges with percentage-closer filtering: average the comparison over the 3 × 3 texels around the position in the cascade's layer.

hint.opengl: `vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(shadowMap, 0));` (the `.xy` of the array's size), then two `for` loops from -1 to 1 with `texture(shadowMap, vec3(projCoords.xy + vec2(x, y) * texelSize, layer)).r` and `shadow /= 9.0;`.
hint.vulkan: `vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(shadowMap, 0));` (the `.xy` of the array's size), two `for` loops from -1 to 1 with `texture(shadowMap, vec3(projCoords.xy + vec2(x, y) * texelSize, layer)).r` and `shadow /= 9.0;`.
hint.d3d12: `uint width, height, elements; shadowMap.GetDimensions(width, height, elements); float2 texelSize = 1.0f / float2(width, height);`, then two `for` loops from -1 to 1 with `shadowMap.Sample(shadowSampler, float3(shadowUV + float2(x, y) * texelSize, layer)).r` and `shadow /= 9.0f;`.
